description: cfd_3d_spin_amr_sub with G 42 0.1: a patch casts the paddle again only when a vertex has moved more than 0.1 of its cell size since its last cast; the stages in between keep that level set (the forcing velocity of each stage).
covers: G 42 > 0: cfd_amr_6dof::unchanged with a tolerance against the triangles of the last cast (propeller speed patch 3, ship_propeller_cfd_amr 261018)
